  PROBLEM: `codex exec` runs with `--sandbox danger-full-access` while sensitive secrets remain in the inherited environment.
  WHY: A model with arbitrary shell access can read the environment or run commands like `env`/`cat /proc/self/environ`, so prompt injection or an over-eager turn can exfiltrate repo-scoped credentials.
- .github/workflows/check_failure_triage.yml:78-94 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The concurrency fallback chain still falls through to `inputs.check_name` and `github.run_id`, which can group unrelated check failures together.
  WHY: When `check_run_id` is empty or the hash job fails, distinct checks on the same PR can serialize behind the same concurrency slot and block each other.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:198-220 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The parent-generation block now exits on missing/malformed `gen=` markers or parent fetch/parse failures instead of defaulting to `GEN=1`.
  WHY: If the parent issue body lacks the marker or a fetch/parse step flakes, the triage run aborts instead of opening a fallback triage issue.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:221-230 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `gh issue list --limit 200` can miss existing triage issues and fail to detect a duplicate fingerprint marker.
  WHY: In repos with more than 200 open `ai:check-triage` issues, the duplicate guard only scans the first page and can create a second issue for the same PR+check.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:212-215 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The shared `parent_generation_missing_or_malformed` log path is ambiguous because it does not distinguish missing markers from parse failures.
  WHY: Operators get the same error text for different failure modes, which makes diagnosis harder.
